title: Seedance 2 refusal shows the error dialog, not a toast
description: A Seedance 2.0 refusal (BytePlus *SensitiveContentDetected*, wrapped as DeepInfra HTTP 500 with a provider 400) was coded PROVIDER_ERROR and raised the 'Cloud generation failed' dialog. A model refusing is not an error: classify it CONTENT_FILTERED and show it as a toast.
